stale_bond.title: Dohm needs re-pairing
stale_bond.description:
Home Assistant can reach the Dohm at {address}, but it connects without ever answering. The Dohm only replies over a paired (encrypted) link, so its pairing key no longer matches the one Home Assistant holds — usually because the top button was pressed since pairing, which grants a new key and replaces the old one.

Hold the top button on the Dohm for ~5 seconds to put it back into pairing mode. It should recover within a minute.

If it doesn't, delete this integration and add it again while holding the button. The Dohm stores only one pairing at a time, so if you've since paired the phone app, that has taken the slot — forget the Dohm there first.
